text.insert: Annotator runs on Windows 10 (2004) and later as the same app, from the same GPUI code: the same capsule, picker, overlay, review window, welcome tour and Settings. Only the parts the operating system owns differ, and they sit behind the
modules. This page covers that split, how each OS part works on Windows, what Windows leaves out, and how the Windows build is made and checked.
Every GPUI view is shared, and only the OS shell differs.

Windows global coordinates are physical pixels, because Annotator is per-monitor DPI aware, with the primary display's top-left as the origin.

steps.text: Open the welcome window on a fresh profile
Copy the Visual C++ runtime DLLs beside `scrawl.exe`
transcribe.cpp's CMake build uses the DLL runtime, so `crt-static` does not link
Download and run the model with `cargo test win::speech -- --ignored`
Run the model again under Intel SDE as a Lunar Lake CPU
The runner has AVX-512, and Lunar Lake does not
The zip holds the unsigned `scrawl.exe`, transcribe.cpp's DLLs, the runtime DLLs, README and LICENSE
If the run has a tag
Attach the zip to the tag's GitHub release
